description: Babysit release checks and session tracking (Claude Code, Codex, Grok Build). OMP uses hooks/omp.ts.

hooks.command: bbs_plugin_root="${GROK_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}}}"; if [ -n "$bbs_plugin_root" ]; then exec bash "$bbs_plugin_root/bin/hooks/pre-tool-gate"; else echo 'Babysit plugin root is missing; reinstall the plugin' >&2; exit 2; fi

bbs_plugin_root="${GROK_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}}}"; if [ -n "$bbs_plugin_root" ]; then exec bash "$bbs_plugin_root/bin/hooks/session-writer"; else echo 'Babysit plugin root is missing; reinstall the plugin' >&2; exit 2; fi
